svg.text: Sheet 2 of 2 | Rev 1.2 | 2026-11-16 | BAE 402 Sake Team
** ENCLOSE ALL 120 VAC WIRING BEFORE ENERGIZING **
** Outlet A only -- never tap fan rail **
Relay Enclosure (TS0012 HV side, 14 AWG, gland-strain-relieved)
Each fan HOT enters relay COM, exits NO when GPIO IN goes LOW (active-LOW).
Neutral and Ground are bussed in parallel to all fans (NOT switched).
HOT BUS-BAR (120 VAC from Outlet B)
Each "COM <-> NO" block is one of 8 channels in the TS0012 module.
* Enclose all 120 VAC wiring before energising. No exposed terminals.
* Pi 5V supply on Outlet A only -- never tap from fan rail (Outlet B).
* Relays switch HOT only. Neutral is bussed in parallel to all loads.
* Fans hold last commanded state during a server crash -- kill power at relay box for hard cutoff.
THINKSCALE wall adapters, one per table-leg scale
ALWAYS-ON, NOT switched by relay (Outlet A side)
Scales auto-zero at power-up: a UPS on Outlet A is advised
Low-voltage DC to each scale; data is Bluetooth LE (Sheet 1)
Replaces HX711 + FX29 load cells (no wiring to the Pi)
